controller_constructor_requirements.root: Replace null with the fresh owned case absolute directory before any grant; no existing old case path.
controller_constructor_requirements.recorderPath: Replace null INSIDE controller_configuration with the absolute pinned recorder file. A separate top-level recorder field is not passed implicitly.

completion_summary_bounds_policy.mandatory_order: The very next tool call after final actual native outcome must be CUA completion_summary only, exactly once. No intervening timestamp tool. Success has one planned quit as last native observer; failure has no extra input/observer/quit.
completion_summary_bounds_policy.receipt_method: Conditional filesystem markers may be retained after observations and before planned Quit. Pair only the final applicable lower marker with the one immediate actual completion_summary return. Earlier conditional markers stay unpaired bookkeeping and are not attempted summary calls.
completion_summary_bounds_policy.timestamp_truth: The conditional marker is a conservative lower bound preceding invocation; external returned receipt is an upper bound. Neither is an exact invocation timestamp. The summary bounds are NOT a native controller API pair; native/external operation trace pairs remain exact.
completion_summary_bounds_policy.clock: Original filesystem clock starts before first case-relevant getState/bootstrap, includes proof/launch/input/waits/observations, and never resets.
completion_summary_bounds_policy.preclock_failure: If no case clock/native operation/launch exists, retain immediate summary tool return without fabricating a native pair, invocation timestamp, elapsed-case value or cap-pass claim.
completion_summary_bounds_policy.bookkeeping: Conditional markers do not add target operations or reset/hide the clock. Preserve exact actual call count and independently record the returned summary upper bound only after that immediate tool return.
